scope: Repair false free-space veto after continuation/save/reload. No new feature, ROS interface, map schema, background job or synchronization primitive.
product_build_identity: Independent UNVERIFIED development builds; no tagged product bundle or installed library replaced.
root_cause: Hard voxel lookup made planar returns discontinuous at cell faces: a 0.1 mm z shift changed the correct pose score from 0.978655 to 0.710234 in a 0.20 m grid.

Veto mode treated any different free-space winner as decisive, while elimination mode already required a score separation relative to sampling variance. Continuous scoring alone exposed two corridor false vetoes for differences near 0.01.
implementation: Trilinear sampling of occupied/free layers at voxel centers; outside-neighbor support stays unknown without renormalization.
Fractional support counts preserve the same evidence across score, coverage and variance; each query point remains one sample, not eight.
Veto and elimination share Score::significantlyBetterThan with the existing reloc_free_space_kill_sigmas value. The numeric default remains 5.0; veto semantics now require meaningful counterevidence.
Registration, temporal confirmation, visibility, ambiguity and motion gates are unchanged. Existing Atlas files remain usable without recompilation.

reference_review.decision: Review continuous interpolation as a mature pattern; implement ordinary trilinear weights locally because this score gate needs no optimizer derivatives. No Cartographer dependency added.

ablation.interpolation_only: Frozen failure resolves and 50 full extension runs pass, but two existing corridor regressions fail; not shipped.
ablation.significance_only_hard_lookup: Frozen failure and the new surface-continuity regression both fail.
ablation.combined: Frozen failure, corridor regressions and complete suites pass.
ablation.strong_counterevidence: The same regression verifies that occupied support still significantly beats a pose inside observed free space and that outside-grid input has no valid score.

measurement_scope: Complete same-input A/B replays at unlimited replay rate, four CPU affinity and four registration threads. CPU seconds divided by unchanged sensor-input duration is equivalent real-time core demand; it is not instantaneous replay CPU. Map loading is measured separately and excluded from that core-demand figure. RSS includes loaded map/cache state.
limits: One full A/B performance pass with interleaved order; small CPU differences are not claimed as speedup.
The 14 positions and both routes are existing simulation datasets. No new RK3588/Jetson or physical-robot qualification.
The shared variance rule is the existing sampling approximation, not a claim of calibrated cross-scene probabilities or independent repeated observations.
FreeSpaceGrid::Score support counters are now double; C++ consumers of that type must rebuild. ROS and persisted formats are unchanged.
